name: test-only-regression
title: A test-only task that adds the missing regression test

task.title: Add regression tests for the overdue boundary
task.goal: Lock in the local-calendar-day behaviour of isOverdue with a regression test.
deliverables: A test that fails on the old isOverdue implementation
The test passes on the current code
definitionOfDone: A regression test fails on the old isOverdue implementation

diff.patch:
diff --git a/src/lib/dates.test.ts b/src/lib/dates.test.ts
index aaaaaaa..bbbbbbb 100644
--- a/src/lib/dates.test.ts
+++ b/src/lib/dates.test.ts
@@ -30,3 +30,19 @@ describe('isOverdue', () => {
   test('yesterday is overdue', () => {
     expect(isOverdue(dateOffset(-1))).toBe(true)
   })
+
+  test('a task due today is not overdue, even late in the day', () => {
+    const now = new Date('2026-03-14T23:30:00')
+    expect(isOverdue('2026-03-14', now)).toBe(false)
+  })
+
+  test('a task due tomorrow is not overdue across the DST boundary', () => {
+    const now = new Date('2026-03-08T01:30:00')
+    expect(isOverdue('2026-03-09', now)).toBe(false)
+  })
+
+  test('yesterday is overdue in local time', () => {
+    const now = new Date('2026-03-14T00:30:00')
+    expect(isOverdue('2026-03-13', now)).toBe(true)
+  })

expected.rationale: Test-only task: the deliverable is the regression test itself. The diff is inside the lane and the suite is green, so no production change is required.
